model.name: qwen3.6-35b-a3b (agent, explain only)
model.about: Alibaba Qwen3.6, mixture of experts (35B, about 3B active), FP8 as published by Qwen. Apache-2.0. Fits an A100 (about 44 GB of 80; FP8 through vLLM's fallback path there). Tests speed against the 27B dense Qwen: far fewer active parameters per token. Thinking off, as for the other Qwen profiles.

answers.sql:
SELECT
    ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
    COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch
    ON f.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS active_customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND IS_ACTV = TRUE

SELECT
    j.dsply_nm AS jurisdiction_name,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j
    ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.dsply_nm
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

SELECT
    br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    dt.CAL_YR_NBR AS calendar_year,
    dt.MTH_NM AS month_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br
    ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY br.DSPLY_NM, dt.CAL_YR_NBR, dt.MTH_NM, dt.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY dt.CAL_YR_NBR, dt.MTH_NBR, br.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dspt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON dspt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT dc.bus_id) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.f_ln_dlq_d f
JOIN bank_dwh.d_cust dc
  ON f.cust_k = dc.cust_k
WHERE f.dflt_flg = TRUE
  AND dc.is_curr = TRUE
  AND f.bus_dt_k = (
    SELECT MAX(d.dt_k)
    FROM bank_dwh.d_dt d
    WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
      AND d.mth_nbr = 8
  )

SELECT
    ctg.dsply_nm AS complaint_category,
    COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ctg
    ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ctg.dsply_nm
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT
    d.CAL_YR_NBR,
    f.CCY_CD1,
    AVG(f.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR, f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR, f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT
    m.dsply_nm AS market_name,
    d.cal_dt AS business_date,
    SUM(f.mkt_val1_amt) AS total_portfolio_value
FROM bank_dwh.f_ptf_val_d f
JOIN bank_dwh.d_mkt m
    ON f.mkt_k = m.mkt_k
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt d
    ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY m.dsply_nm, d.cal_dt
ORDER BY total_portfolio_value DESC;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS account_count,
  ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE IS_CURR = true
  AND OPND_DT >= '2025-01-01'
  AND OPND_DT < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT
    br.CTY_NM AS branch_city,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br
    ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.QTR_NBR = 1
GROUP BY br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY br.CTY_NM;

SELECT
  AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30'

SELECT
  AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT
    d.MTH_NBR,
    COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY customer_segment;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_with_no_transactions_2025
FROM bank_dwh.d_cust c
WHERE c.is_curr = true
  AND c.cust_k NOT IN (
      SELECT ft.cust_k
      FROM bank_dwh.f_acct_txn ft
      JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt d ON ft.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
      WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
  );

SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN fa.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    / COUNT(*),
    2
  ) AS declined_pct
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH fa
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON fa.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT
    ctg.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaints_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ctg
    ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ctg.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY ctg.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT
    chnl.dsply_nm AS channel_name,
    SUM(ftn.fee_amt) AS total_fees
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN ftn
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL chnl
    ON ftn.chnl_k = chnl.chnl_k
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
    ON ftn.bus_dt_k = dt.dt_k
WHERE dt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY chnl.dsply_nm
ORDER BY chnl.dsply_nm;

SELECT
  SUM(fd.TXN_AMT) AS total_dispute_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT fd
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON fd.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE fd.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT
    j.dsply_nm AS jurisdiction_name,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j
    ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.dsply_nm
ORDER BY j.dsply_nm;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans_more_than_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
WHERE BUS_DT_K = 20250831
  AND DYS_PST_DUE > 90

SELECT
    d.CAL_YR_NBR AS transaction_year,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c
    ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = true
  AND c.DSPLY_NM ILIKE '%Mobile App%'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT
    dp.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
    SUM(fb.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D fb
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD dp
    ON fb.LN_PRD_K = dp.LN_PRD_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
    ON fb.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY dp.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY dp.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_sme_customers_with_cross_border_wire
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c
    ON w.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = true
  AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND w.IS_CRSS_BRDR = true
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH atm_by_branch AS (
    SELECT
        br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
        br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
        br.BUS_ID AS branch_id,
        COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br
        ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
        ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND br.IS_CURR = TRUE
    GROUP BY br.RGN_CD1, br.DSPLY_NM, br.BUS_ID
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        region_code,
        branch_name,
        atm_txn_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region_code ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC) AS rn
    FROM atm_by_branch
)
SELECT
    region_code,
    branch_name,
    atm_txn_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

SELECT
  mc.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code,
  SUM(a.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_authorization_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH m ON a.MRCH_K = m.MRCH_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH_CTG mc
  ON m.MRCH_CTG_CD1 = mc.MRCH_CTG_CD1
  AND mc.IS_CURR = TRUE
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY mc.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_authorization_amount DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT
  c.BUS_ID,
  SUM(w.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c
  ON w.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY c.BUS_ID
ORDER BY total_wire_amount DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
    w.STLM_CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
    SUM(w.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY w.STLM_CCY_CD1
ORDER BY w.STLM_CCY_CD1;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT wc.bus_id) AS distinct_customers
FROM bank_dwh.f_wr_trf w
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt wdt ON w.bus_dt_k = wdt.dt_k
JOIN bank_dwh.d_cust wc ON w.cust_k = wc.cust_k
WHERE wdt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
  AND wc.is_curr = true
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.f_atm_txn a
    JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt adt ON a.bus_dt_k = adt.dt_k
    WHERE a.cust_k = w.cust_k
      AND adt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
  )

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT
  d.CAL_YR_NBR AS yr,
  COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NOT d.IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekday_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

WITH june_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        ab.ACCT_K,
        ab.CLSNG_BAL_AMT AS june_balance
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D ab
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON ab.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30'
),
dec_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        ab.ACCT_K,
        ab.CLSNG_BAL_AMT AS dec_balance
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D ab
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON ab.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS account_count
FROM june_2025 j
JOIN dec_2025 d ON j.ACCT_K = d.ACCT_K
WHERE j.june_balance > 0
  AND d.dec_balance < (j.june_balance * 0.9);

SELECT
    cat.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
    AVG(
        EXTRACT(DAY FROM (f.RSLTN_AT - f.CNTCT_STRTD_AT))
    ) AS avg_days_to_resolution
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG cat
    ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = cat.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.IS_RSLVD = TRUE
  AND f.CNTCT_STRTD_AT IS NOT NULL
  AND f.RSLTN_AT IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY cat.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY cat.DSPLY_NM;

WITH current_versions AS (
    SELECT
        BUS_ID,
        CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
        VRSN_NBR
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
    WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
),
previous_versions AS (
    SELECT
        BUS_ID,
        CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
        VRSN_NBR
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
    WHERE IS_CURR = FALSE
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_customers_with_segment_change
FROM current_versions cv
JOIN previous_versions pv
    ON cv.BUS_ID = pv.BUS_ID
    AND cv.VRSN_NBR = pv.VRSN_NBR + 1
WHERE cv.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 != pv.CUST_SGMNT_CD1
   OR (cv.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 IS NULL AND pv.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 IS NOT NULL)
   OR (cv.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 IS NOT NULL AND pv.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 IS NULL);

WITH txn_quarters AS (
    SELECT
        dc.bus_id,
        dd.cal_yr_nbr,
        dd.qtr_nbr
    FROM bank_dwh.f_acct_txn fat
    JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt dd ON fat.bus_dt_k = dd.dt_k
    JOIN bank_dwh.d_cust dc ON fat.cust_k = dc.cust_k
    WHERE dc.is_curr = true
      AND dd.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
    GROUP BY dc.bus_id, dd.cal_yr_nbr, dd.qtr_nbr
),
cust_quarter_count AS (
    SELECT
        bus_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT qtr_nbr) AS qtr_cnt
    FROM txn_quarters
    GROUP BY bus_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers_all_quarters
FROM cust_quarter_count
WHERE qtr_cnt = 4;

WITH disputes_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
wire_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT w.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM disputes_2025 d
WHERE d.CUST_K NOT IN (SELECT CUST_K FROM wire_2025);

WITH jun2024 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT LN_ID
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
    WHERE BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2024-06-30')
      AND DYS_PST_DUE = 0
),
jun2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT LN_ID
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
    WHERE BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-06-30')
      AND DYS_PST_DUE > 30
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM jun2024 j24
INNER JOIN jun2025 j25 ON j24.LN_ID = j25.LN_ID

SELECT
  wt.CCY_CD1,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY wt.STLM_AMT) AS median_amt
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON wt.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND wt.STLM_AMT IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY wt.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY wt.CCY_CD1;

WITH mobile_txn_counts AS (
    SELECT
        d.CAL_YR_NBR,
        COUNT(*) AS txn_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE c.IS_CURR = true
      AND c.DSPLY_NM ILIKE '%Mobile App%'
    GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
)
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 THEN txn_count ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_2025,
    MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_YR_NBR = 2024 THEN txn_count ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_2024,
    CASE
        WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_YR_NBR = 2024 THEN txn_count ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (
            (MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 THEN txn_count ELSE 0 END) -
             MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_YR_NBR = 2024 THEN txn_count ELSE 0 END)) *
            100.0 /
            MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_YR_NBR = 2024 THEN txn_count ELSE 0 END)
        )
    END AS growth_pct
FROM mobile_txn_counts;

WITH last_day_balances AS (
    SELECT
        d.MTH_NBR,
        d.CAL_DT,
        SUM(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing_balance
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND d.IS_MTH_END = TRUE
    GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR, d.CAL_DT
)
SELECT
    MTH_NBR,
    total_closing_balance
FROM last_day_balances
ORDER BY MTH_NBR;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  ON c.CUST_K = t.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt_txn
  ON t.BUS_DT_K = dt_txn.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt_cust
  ON c.CUST_SNC_DT = dt_cust.CAL_DT
WHERE c.IS_CURR = true
  AND dt_cust.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt_txn.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT
  dc.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT dc.BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST dc
WHERE dc.EFF_FRM_DT <= DATE '2023-06-30'
  AND (dc.EFF_TO_DT > DATE '2023-06-30' OR dc.EFF_TO_DT IS NULL)
GROUP BY dc.CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY dc.CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH wire_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        wt.CUST_K,
        SUM(wt.AMT::NUMERIC) AS total_amt
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wt
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON wt.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY wt.CUST_K
),
current_cust AS (
    SELECT
        CUST_K,
        BUS_ID,
        CUST_SGMNT_CD1
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
    WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        cc.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment_code,
        cc.BUS_ID,
        w25.total_amt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY cc.CUST_SGMNT_CD1
            ORDER BY w25.total_amt DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM wire_2025 w25
    JOIN current_cust cc ON w25.CUST_K = cc.CUST_K
)
SELECT
    segment_code,
    BUS_ID,
    total_amt
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY segment_code, rn;

SELECT
  f.CCY_CD1,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY pct DESC

WITH monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT
    d.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
    COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT
  month_number,
  wire_transfer_count,
  SUM(wire_transfer_count) OVER (ORDER BY month_number) AS running_total
FROM monthly_counts
ORDER BY month_number;

WITH wr_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        f.ORGNL_AMT,
        f.ORGNL_CCY_CD1,
        d.CAL_DT
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
fx_rates AS (
    SELECT
        BUS_DT_K,
        CCY_CD1,
        MID_RT
    FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D

SELECT
  f.CCY_CD1,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY pct DESC

WITH monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT
    d.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
    COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT
  month_number,
  wire_transfer_count,
  SUM(wire_transfer_count) OVER (ORDER BY month_number) AS running_total
FROM monthly_counts
ORDER BY month_number;

WITH wire_transfers AS (
    SELECT
        f.ORGNL_AMT,
        f.ORGNL_CCY_CD1,
        d.CAL_DT
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
fx_rates AS (
    SELECT
        CCY_CD1,
        BUS_DT_K,
        MID_RT
    FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D
    WHERE QUOT_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR'
)
SELECT
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN wt.ORGNL_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN wt.ORGNL_AMT
            ELSE wt.ORGNL_AMT / fr.MID_RT
        END
    ) AS total_wire_transfer_amount_eur
FROM wire_transfers wt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON wt.CAL_DT = d.CAL_DT
LEFT JOIN fx_rates fr
    ON wt.ORGNL_CCY_CD1 = fr.CCY_CD1
    AND wt.CAL_DT = d.CAL_DT
    AND fr.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE fr.MID_RT IS NOT NULL OR wt.ORGNL_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR';

WITH auth_stats AS (
    SELECT
        d.MTH_NBR,
        COUNT(*) AS total_auths,
        SUM(CASE WHEN a.EVNT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS declined_auths
    FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT
    MTH_NBR,
    (declined_auths * 100.0 / total_auths) AS decline_share_pct
FROM auth_stats
ORDER BY decline_share_pct DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  f.STLM_CCY_CD1 AS currency,
  SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.STLM_CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_volume DESC;

SELECT
    ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
    COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch
    ON f.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS active_customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND IS_ACTV = TRUE

SELECT
    j.dsply_nm AS jurisdiction_name,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j
    ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.dsply_nm
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

SELECT
    br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    dt.CAL_YR_NBR AS calendar_year,
    dt.MTH_NM AS month_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br
    ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY br.DSPLY_NM, dt.CAL_YR_NBR, dt.MTH_NM, dt.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY dt.CAL_YR_NBR, dt.MTH_NBR, br.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dspt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON dspt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

WITH aug_2025_last_day AS (
  SELECT MAX(DT_K) AS last_day_k
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND MTH_NBR = 8
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON d.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN aug_2025_last_day last ON dt.DT_K = last.last_day_k
WHERE d.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE

SELECT
    ctg.dsply_nm AS complaint_category,
    COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ctg
    ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ctg.dsply_nm
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT
  d.CAL_YR_NBR,
  f.CCY_CD1,
  AVG(f.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR, f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR, f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT
    m.dsply_nm AS market_name,
    d.cal_dt AS business_date,
    SUM(f.mkt_val1_amt) AS total_market_value
FROM bank_dwh.f_ptf_val_d f
JOIN bank_dwh.d_mkt m
    ON f.mkt_k = m.mkt_k
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt d
    ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY m.dsply_nm, d.cal_dt
ORDER BY m.dsply_nm, d.cal_dt;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS account_count,
    ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE IS_CURR = true
  AND OPND_DT >= '2025-01-01'
  AND OPND_DT < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT
    br.CTY_NM AS branch_city,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.QTR_NBR = 1
GROUP BY br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY br.CTY_NM;

SELECT
  AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30';

SELECT
  AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT
    d.MTH_NBR,
    COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY customer_segment;

WITH transacting_custs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ft.cust_k
    FROM bank_dwh.f_acct_txn ft
    JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt d ON ft.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
    WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_with_no_transactions_2025
FROM bank_dwh.d_cust c
WHERE c.is_curr = true
  AND c.bus_id NOT IN (
      SELECT tc.bus_id
      FROM bank_dwh.d_cust tc
      JOIN transacting_custs t ON tc.cust_k = t.cust_k
  );

SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN fa.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    2
  ) AS declined_pct
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH fa
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON fa.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT
    ctg.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaints_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ctg
    ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
    AND ctg.IS_CURR = TRUE
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND f.BUS_DT_K >= 20250101
  AND f.BUS_DT_K <= 20251231
GROUP BY ctg.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY ctg.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT
    chnl.dsply_nm AS channel_name,
    SUM(ftn.fee_amt) AS total_fees
FROM bank_dwh.f_acct_txn ftn
JOIN bank_dwh.d_chnl chnl
    ON ftn.chnl_k = chnl.chnl_k
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt dt
    ON ftn.bus_dt_k = dt.dt_k
WHERE dt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY chnl.dsply_nm
ORDER BY chnl.dsply_nm;

SELECT
  SUM(fd.TXN_AMT) AS total_dispute_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT fd
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON fd.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE fd.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT
    j.dsply_nm AS jurisdiction_name,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j
    ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE j.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.dsply_nm
ORDER BY j.dsply_nm;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND f.DYS_PST_DUE > 90

WITH mobile_channel AS (
    SELECT
        ch.CHNL_K
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch
    WHERE ch.IS_CURR = true
      AND (
          ch.DSPLY_NM ILIKE '%Mobile App%'
          OR ch.CHNL_TYP_CD1 ILIKE '%Mobile%'
      )
),
filtered_txns AS (
    SELECT
        f.ACCT_TXN_F_K,
        d.CAL_YR_NBR
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
    JOIN mobile_channel mc ON f.CHNL_K = mc.CHNL_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
)
SELECT
    CAL_YR_NBR AS transaction_year,
    COUNT(*) AS account_transaction_count
FROM filtered_txns
GROUP BY CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY CAL_YR_NBR;

WITH target_date AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
),
latest_balance AS (
  SELECT
    fb.LN_PRD_K,
    SUM(fb.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D fb
  JOIN target_date td ON fb.BUS_DT_K = td.DT_K
  GROUP BY fb.LN_PRD_K
)
SELECT
  lp.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
  lb.total_outstanding_principal
FROM latest_balance lb
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD lp ON lb.LN_PRD_K = lp.LN_PRD_K
ORDER BY loan_product_name;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_sme_customers_with_cross_border_wire
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c
  ON w.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND w.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

WITH atm_by_branch AS (
    SELECT
        br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
        br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
        br.BUS_ID AS branch_id,
        COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND br.IS_CURR = TRUE
    GROUP BY br.RGN_CD1, br.DSPLY_NM, br.BUS_ID
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        region_code,
        branch_name,
        atm_txn_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region_code ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC) AS rn
    FROM atm_by_branch
)
SELECT
    region_code,
    branch_name,
    atm_txn_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

SELECT
    mc.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code,
    SUM(fa.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH fa
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON fa.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH m ON fa.MRCH_K = m.MRCH_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH_CTG mc ON m.MRCH_CTG_CD1 = mc.MRCH_CTG_CD1
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY mc.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
  c.BUS_ID,
  SUM(w.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c
  ON w.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY c.BUS_ID
ORDER BY total_wire_amount DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
    w.STLM_CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
    SUM(w.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY w.STLM_CCY_CD1
ORDER BY w.STLM_CCY_CD1;

WITH wire_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT wt.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wt
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND wt.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
),
atm_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT at.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN at
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON at.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND at.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers_with_both
FROM wire_customers wc
INNER JOIN atm_customers ac ON wc.CUST_K = ac.CUST_K;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT
  d.CAL_YR_NBR AS yr,
  COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NOT d.IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekday_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

WITH june_30 AS (
    SELECT
        f.ACCT_K,
        f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT AS bal_jun
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30'
),
dec_31 AS (
    SELECT
        f.ACCT_K,
        f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT AS bal_dec
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS acct_cnt
FROM dec_31 d
JOIN june_30 j ON d.ACCT_K = j.ACCT_K
WHERE j.bal_jun > 0
  AND d.bal_dec < j.bal_jun * 0.9;

SELECT
    ctg.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
    AVG(EXTRACT(DAY FROM c.RSLTN_AT - c.CNTCT_STRTD_AT)) AS avg_days_to_resolution
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT c
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ctg
    ON c.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON c.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND c.IS_RSLVD = TRUE
  AND c.CNTCT_STRTD_AT IS NOT NULL
  AND c.RSLTN_AT IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ctg.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY ctg.DSPLY_NM;

WITH current_versions AS (
    SELECT
        BUS_ID,
        CUST_SGMNT_CD1
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
    WHERE IS_CURR = true
),
previous_versions AS (
    SELECT
        BUS_ID,
        CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
        VRSN_NBR
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
    WHERE IS_CURR = false
)
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT cv.BUS_ID) AS customers_with_segment_change
FROM current_versions cv
INNER JOIN previous_versions pv
    ON cv.BUS_ID = pv.BUS_ID
    AND pv.VRSN_NBR = (
        SELECT MAX(pv2.VRSN_NBR)
        FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST pv2
        WHERE pv2.BUS_ID = cv.BUS_ID
          AND pv2.IS_CURR = false
    )
WHERE cv.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 <> pv.CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH txn_quarters AS (
    SELECT
        dc.bus_id,
        dd.cal_yr_nbr,
        dd.qtr_nbr,
        COUNT(DISTINCT fat.acct_txn_f_k) AS txn_count
    FROM bank_dwh.f_acct_txn fat
    JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt dd ON fat.bus_dt_k = dd.dt_k
    JOIN bank_dwh.d_cust dc ON fat.cust_k = dc.cust_k
    WHERE dd.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
      AND dc.is_curr = true
    GROUP BY dc.bus_id, dd.cal_yr_nbr, dd.qtr_nbr
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT fat.acct_txn_f_k) > 0
),
cust_quarters AS (
    SELECT
        bus_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT qtr_nbr) AS qtrs_with_txns
    FROM txn_quarters
    GROUP BY bus_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers_all_quarters
FROM cust_quarters
WHERE qtrs_with_txns = 4;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT dc.BUS_ID) AS cnt_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST dc ON f.CUST_K = dc.CUST_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
  AND dc.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND dc.BUS_ID NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT dc2.BUS_ID
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f2
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d2 ON f2.BUS_DT_K = d2.DT_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST dc2 ON f2.CUST_K = dc2.CUST_K
    WHERE d2.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND f2.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
      AND dc2.IS_CURR = TRUE
  );

WITH june_2024 AS (
    SELECT d.DT_K AS dt_k_2024
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d
    WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2024-06-30'
),
june_2025 AS (
    SELECT d.DT_K AS dt_k_2025
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d
    WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30'
),
loans_2024 AS (
    SELECT f.LN_ID
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
    JOIN june_2024 j24 ON f.BUS_DT_K = j24.dt_k_2024
    WHERE f.DYS_PST_DUE = 0
),
loans_2025 AS (
    SELECT f.LN_ID
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
    JOIN june_2025 j25 ON f.BUS_DT_K = j25.dt_k_2025
    WHERE f.DYS_PST_DUE > 30
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l24.LN_ID) AS loan_count
FROM loans_2024 l24
JOIN loans_2025 l25 ON l24.LN_ID = l25.LN_ID

SELECT
  f.CCY_CD1,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY f.AMT::NUMERIC) AS median_amt
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.AMT IS NOT NULL
  AND f.AMT != ''
  AND f.CCY_CD1 IS NOT NULL
  AND f.CCY_CD1 != ''
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1

WITH last_day_balances AS (
    SELECT
        d.MTH_NBR,
        d.CAL_DT,
        SUM(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing_balance
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND d.IS_MTH_END = TRUE
    GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR, d.CAL_DT
)
SELECT
    MTH_NBR,
    total_closing_balance
FROM last_day_balances
ORDER BY MTH_NBR;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS customers_with_txn_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT bus_dt
  ON t.BUS_DT_K = bus_dt.DT_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = true
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.CUST_SNC_DT) = 2025
  AND bus_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT
  dc.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT dc.BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST dc
WHERE dc.EFF_FRM_DT <= DATE '2023-06-30'
  AND (dc.EFF_TO_DT > DATE '2023-06-30' OR dc.EFF_TO_DT IS NULL)
GROUP BY dc.CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY dc.CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH wire_totals AS (
    SELECT
        dc.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment_code,
        dc.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id,
        SUM(fwt.AMT::NUMERIC) AS total_wire_amount
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF fwt
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON fwt.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST dc ON fwt.CUST_K = dc.CUST_K
    WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND dc.IS_CURR = TRUE
    GROUP BY dc.CUST_SGMNT_CD1, dc.BUS_ID
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        segment_code,
        customer_business_id,
        total_wire_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY segment_code
            ORDER BY total_wire_amount DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM wire_totals
)
SELECT
    segment_code,
    customer_business_id,
    total_wire_amount
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY segment_code, rn;

SELECT
  f.CCY_CD1,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY pct DESC

WITH monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT
    d.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
    COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT
  month_number,
  wire_transfer_count,
  SUM(wire_transfer_count) OVER (ORDER BY month_number) AS running_total
FROM monthly_counts
ORDER BY month_number;

WITH wr_trf_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        f.ORGNL_AMT,
        f.ORGNL_CCY_CD1,
        f.BUS_DT_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
fx_rates AS (
    SELECT
        fx.CCY_CD1,
        fx.RT_DT_K,
        fx.MID_RT
    FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx
    WHERE fx.BS_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR'
      AND fx.RT_TYP_CD1 = 'MID'
)
SELECT
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN w.ORGNL_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN w.ORGNL_AMT
            ELSE w.ORGNL_AMT / f.MID_RT
        END
    ) AS total_wire_transfer_amount_eur
FROM wr_trf_2025 w
LEFT JOIN fx_rates f
    ON w.ORGNL_CCY_CD1 = f.CCY_CD1
   AND w.BUS_DT_K = f.RT_DT_K;

SELECT
    w.STLM_CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
    SUM(w.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY w.STLM_CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_volume DESC;
